TaskPresentation.Summary: Create sorcery Songs with wizardy research. Continue until the game requires rest.
TaskPresentation.Requirements: Wizard · 500 gold per Parchment Scroll · room in your inventory
TaskPresentation.HowItWorks:
Buy one Parchment Scroll from Dar, research, then buy the next.

Ready to begin → Specific → sorcery → Alone or Assistant. A saved assistant must be a registered wizard; the task walks them to the shop.

Step away from the research tiles and return between attempts. When any Song reaches 25, bank it remotely through Dar.

The game's rest refusal starts a 12-hour wait before the next check. Unknown results pause for review. Submitted purchases, research and deposits are checked before continuing.
